title: Scaling Studio: Fleet operator change catalog and throughput lens
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Problem statement: Operators and SREs need a concise way in Console to inspect what changed across fleet scaling configurations, understand historical throughput impact, and quickly apply guarded scaling presets. Existing audit logs are verbose and engineering-facing; we need a curated, operator-first surface that ties change events to throughput deltas and recommended rollback actions.

Goal: Ship the "Scaling Studio" UI panel in Console (left nav: Fleet > Scaling Studio) that contains: 1) a curated Change Catalog (timeline view with humanized entries and links to PRs/config), 2) a Throughput Lens dashboard showing 7/30/90-day trends, per-model QPS and tail latencies, and 3) Operator Presets for applying safe autoscale policies (Aggressive/Balanced/Conservative) with simulated impact.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: implementation of new backend telemetry collectors (we'll consume existing telemetry streams); RBAC gating beyond existing fleet permissions.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Change Catalog shows humanized entries for all scaling-relevant events (policy edits, manual overrides, capacity commits) with link to the originating PR/console action. 2) Throughput Lens includes a 'delta overlay' to correlate events with throughput/latency changes. 3) Operator Presets can be previewed in-situ with simulated capacity/latency deltas and applied to a selected fleet. 4) Unit and e2e tests for front-end components + a basic integration smoke test against staging telemetry.

Metrics for success: reduced investigation time for capacity incidents (target: 30% faster median MTTR for scaling incidents within first month), adoption of Operator Presets in at least 25% of pilot fleets, no regression in console load time (> 250ms additional time for panel open is unacceptable).

notes:
Design decision: show 'simulated headroom' using a conservative cost model (matches Optimize recommendations) to avoid over-promising capacity gains.

Engineering tradeoff: To keep initial rollout low-risk we will sample throughput at 1m resolution and provide an option to expand to 10s resolution per fleet in a follow-up ticket.

Rollout plan: alpha behind feature flag for pilot fleets (fleet IDs provided by SRE); collect operator feedback for 2 weeks; then gated gradual rollout to all dedicated customers.
